meaning:
teeth, fangs, incisors
Also means: mal.ta.ah (מַלְתָּעָה "tooth" H4459)

renderings.bsb: and its fangs are the fangs
renderings.kjv: and he hath the cheek teeth

elsewhere.note: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
